title: A Study to Determine Number of Patients Who Develop High Ammonia Levels After Receiving Recombinant Erwinia Asparaginase
official: A Pilot Study to Establish Incidence and Characteristics of Patients at Risk for Symptomatic Hyperammonemia Secondary to Recombinant Erwinia Asparaginase
summary: This study evaluates the incidence of symptomatic hyperammonemia (high ammonia levels) in patients being treated with recombinant Erwinia asparaginase.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Followed by pediatric hematology/oncology
* Receiving recombinant Erwinia asparaginase for treatment of malignancy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients \< 1 year of age
* Patients who have previously received recombinant Erwinia asparaginase within the past two weeks
